html:
Greetings, Agents. 

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Skillful Mutant mercenaries have gathered to stop the
Omega-level clone and his evil ally with Carbonadium tentacles!
The theme of the August Update is <X-Force Vol.2>.

 

Cable has become the incarnation of war with his Tier-4 Advancement,
and the lucky assassin, Domino, will chase evil Mutants
with her new Uniform and Warpath’s abilities.

 

Look out for the counterattack of 
Stryfe, who has become stronger with Tier-3, 
and the new Super Villain, Omega Red,
who have noticed that they have been targeted by the X-Force Team! 

 

Try out Shadowland which has been improved and will now be the new battlefield of Mutants.

 

Various improvements such as the addition of the new Custom Gear, C.T.P. of Conquest,   
and new normal Comic Cards with Additional Pierce Damage Increase as an option 
have been made, so don’t miss the changes! 

 


▣ One New Hero

 

Omega Red, who has Carbonadium tentacles, 
had to fight against other Mutants endlessly to retain his abilities. 
Omega Red <Modern> has been added.
* The hero skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.
* The schedule and details of the X-Force Vol.2 Themed Update Celebration Event will be announced further.

 

 

 

▣ Three New Uniforms

 

The clone with Omega-level abilities and the mercenaries of X-Force are confronting each other!
Check out the Abilities of Cable <Heart of Darkness>, Stryfe <Classic>, and Domino <Krakoa X-Force>.
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats. (Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)      
* The three new uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <August New Update Celebration Event!>, 
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room after the event.

 

 

 


▣ Cable Tier-4

 

Cable is now available for Tier-4 Advancement.
Cable will concentrate his mind to take down his enemies with bursting telekinesis. 
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ Stryfe Tier-3

 

Stryfe is now available for Tier-3 Advancement.
Stryfe has exceeded the limits of a clone and can now control all his abilities flawlessly. 

 

 

 


▣ Domino & Warpath Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential

 

Through the August Update, Domino and Warpath will acquire Potential Awakening & Transcendence!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 


▣ Shadowland Improvements 

 

Battle in Shadowland more conveniently and collect Tokens 
to exchange for various growth materials at the exclusive shop! 

 

1. The Auto Progress feature has been added to floors 1 to 15.
- Proceed with battles of the current season conveniently 
with the same setting of the clear record of the previous season.
* Auto Progress may not be available when there are no records from previous seasons, 

when the hero has been used on another floor and is not available, 

or when there are not enough Clear Tickets.

 

 

2. The Stage / Batch Clear feature has been added to floors 1 to 25.
- Only Agents who have purchased the [S.H.I.E.L.D. Special Support] 
can use Batch Clear using the same setting with the clear record of the previous season.
- The stages can be cleared without battles.
* Batch Clear may not be available when there are no records from previous seasons, 
when the hero has been used on another floor and is not available, 
or when there are not enough Clear Tickets.
* A floor that has already been cleared manually cannot be cleared. 
* Heroes used when Batch Clearing the stages will not be available until the reset.
* Auto-Progress will be replaced with Batch Clear when Batch Clear is available.

 

 

 

 

3. The Shadowland Shop has been added.
- The Shadowland Tokens can be used to purchase items at the Shadowland Shop.
- Shadowland Tokens can be acquired from floor 36 depending on the number of surviving heroes.
- Agents can possess up to 60,000 Tokens.
- Some items have a purchase limit, which is reset based on a specific period.
* Agents with the [S.H.I.E.L.D. Special Support] can receive additional Tokens.

 

 

* Various items such as 6 types of C.T.P.s, 5-6★ Custom Gear, Comic Card, Uru, 
and 6★ (Awakened) ISO-8 can be acquired from the Shadowland Chest based on chances.   
Please check the list of items that can be acquired from each Selector in-game.
* The C.T.P. of Conquest cannot be acquired from the Dimension Chest: C.T.P. x1.   

       

4. Auto Play + can now be used without having to purchase the S.H.I.E.L.D. Special Support.
* The [Auto Play+] benefit has been changed to [Batch Clear] and [Additional Shadowland Token] benefits.

 

5. The Power Saving Mode can now be used when battling.

 

6. The three stages that used to appear randomly have been changed to three fixed stages.
Heroes used in previous seasons will be saved based on the changed stages.

 

7. The conditions and heroes (Super Villains) that appear in some stages have been changed.

 

8. The clear record and progress of previous seasons will be applied as below after the August Update. 
- The clear record of previous seasons that have been 

completed until the following period will not be discarded. 
8/18 (Fri) 1:00 - 8/25 (Fri) 0:59 (UTC+0),   8/17 (Thu) 18:00 - 8/24 (Thu) 17:59 (PDT)
- The progress of previous seasons 
that have been completed until the following period will not be applied. 
8/25 (Fri) 1:00 - Until the August Update (UTC+0), 8/24 (Thu) 18:00 - Until the August Update (PDT)
- Some stages have been discarded as the stages for each floor have been fixed.
- When there are stages that have been discarded in stages 36 and above,
the stages will be changed to a stage from the 1st floor after the update.
* The Highest Cleared Floor information achieved before the update will not be changed.
* Only clear records that have been made after the update will be applied as the 
‘previous season clear record’, and can be used to Auto Progress / Batch clear stages.

 


▣ Battle Content Improvements

 

1. The Boost Point usage can now be set to ‘Always Max’ in Giant Boss Raid.

 

 

2. Agents can now proceed from the first stage of the theme when Auto Progressing Story.

 

 

3. Gained/lost points can now be checked when the Otherworld Battle fight ends.

 

4. Debuffed heroes can now be checked 

at the hero deployment screen in Otherworld Battle after a match has been made.

 

5. The image of the Special Icon will now not be revealed 
in the [Otherworld Battle League Info] → [Rewards] tab.

 

6. The abilities of opponents in the first difficulty of Dimension Rift have been decreased.

 


▣ New C.T.P. & Reforging    

 

The C.T.P. of Conquest has been added as a new Custom Gear.
Try out the abilities Wall, which decreases damage received when hit,
and Clash, which increases the damage dealt to enemies.

* The options are based on the maximum stats.
* One of the two reforge options will be selected randomly based on the chances.

 

 


▣ New Comic Cards and Collection 

 

Five new Comic Cards with Doctor Strange as the theme have been added.
Collect these Comic Cards with additional Pierce damage increase as an option and upgrade all of them 

to Mythic to acquire the All Basic Attacks Increase +4% effect as a collection reward.
* The new Cards can be acquired in the Store.
* The effects are based on the highest quality and rank.

 

[8/30 (Wed) 10:05 (UTC+0), 8/30 (Wed) 3:05 (PDT) added]

Please note that the five Doctor Strange themed Comic Cards cannot be acquired 

from the Comic Card Chance-Up Event that has been progressed before the August Update

throughout 8/28 (Mon) 15:00 - 9/1 (Fri) 14:59 (UTC+0), 8/28 (Mon) 8:00 - 9/1 (Fri) 7:59 (PDT).

 

Please purchase the Comic Card Chest 

after 9/1 (Fri) 15:00 (UTC+0), 9/1 (Fri) 8:00 (PDT)

if you are aiming to acquire the new Comic Cards.

 

 

 

 

 

 


▣ New Artifacts

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Cable, Stryfe, Omega Red, 

Domino, and Warpath will be added after the August Update.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary / Mythic Future Pass that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season 

the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season. 
Please don’t forget to check the remaining event time.
- The Mythic Pass can be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Passes will not be available for purchase 
when the season is about to end. Please check the sale schedule in the game.
          
​New Special Icons that will represent you have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards, 
one as Otherworld Battle rewards, and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[August Update New Special Icon]
         

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms of the X-Force Vol.2 theme.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. The Alliance → Support feature has been improved.
- The number of supports that can be made has been changed from three to ten.
- The maximum number of items that can be acquired has been increased.
- An option to select the number of items to support each time has been added.
- Multiple Agents can support the same request, and the support result screen 
where Agents who have made support can be checked has been added.
- Agents who have made support before the August Update cannot be checked.

 

 

2. The Artifact and Uniform effect can now be checked in the Marvel Universe.

 

 

3. Agents can now stop Craft by 10 times when proceeding with Craft more than 10 times.
Also, the Craft animation will no longer be shown after tapping Skip.

 

 

4. Agents can now proceed with Craft regardless of the number of items 
that will be acquired when there is at least one space in the Inventory.
- When the Inventory gets full during Crafting, Craft will stop by ten times.

 

5. Agents can acquire a trial Uniform for the 50% discount Uniform of the Guided Quest
as a mission reward when proceeding with a new Tier-2 Guided Quest after the August Update.
- The Trial Uniform will be given as normal rank and can be upgraded.
- The Uniform rank will not be changed when the trial period has ended.
- The Trial Uniform will not be given if you already possess the Uniform.
- The Trial Uniform that has been equipped will be retrieved
when receiving the reward for the last mission of the Guided Quest.

 

6. The information and convenience of the in-game Chance Info have been improved. 
- Texts informing the location of Chance Info that is displayed at a different location 
when checking the Chance Info at the Store or in Craft have been added.
- The acquisition chance of Comic Card / Artifact options 
has been added to the Chance Info on the main lobby screen.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The graphic being displayed abnormally 
on the skill preview pop-up screen of some heroes has been fixed.

 

2. Used heroes being displayed on the top 
when using the Shadowland team setting filter in ascending order has been fixed.

 

3. The Artifact dismantle feature being disabled in the Inventory under certain situations has been fixed.

 

4. The Hero Info button at the upper right corner of the pop-up screen 
that appears when tapping the magnifying glass at the hero list 
when using Biometrics to increase the level of a hero not working has been fixed.
 
5. The number of Clear Tickets that are used to clear each stage being displayed as 0 
when beginning Multiverse Invasion and Timeline battle as Auto-Repeat 
and turning the Auto-Repeat button on again during the battle has been fixed.
 
6. The Leader Skill of Kang the Conqueror <Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania> 
being applied to all heroes has been fixed.  

 

7. The Biometric / X-Gene of native Tier-2&3 heroes will not be used as hero level-up material.

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
